'''Xenon''' was an element used in [[light sculpture]]s to create a shining, visual specter.

{{Science-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Xenon is a real-world [[Wikipedia: chemical element|chemical element]]. It is a heavy, colorless, odorless gas that causes narcosis if inhaled. It is very unreactive and reluctantly forms compounds, which are strong oxidizers.
